orsino_life_cleric.name: Life cleric
orsino_life_cleric.role: Orsino healing amounts: Luminous Touch scales with level; Cure Minor Wounds restores 1d4. Knows shrine observances. Kyr class chassis and mana costs.
orsino_life_cleric.supersededBy: cleric with the vitalist specialization (cure_minor). Luminous Touch is a light-domain spell in Orsino.

orsino_abjurer.name: Abjurer
orsino_abjurer.role: Fireproof ward grants the Orsino status’s 50% fire resistance, in battle or before entering danger. Kyr class chassis and duration.
orsino_abjurer.supersededBy: cleric with the vitalist specialization (resist_fire). Orsino gives fireproof to the life and ocean domains, not the abjuration school.
